title: Mines To Minds | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Mines To Minds. Category: Entrepreneurship. Duration: 6 months. Description: A professional vocational training program providing the youth of Balochistan with practical training in mining, geological exploration, drilling support, safety, GPS mapping, sample management, and digital field administration. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
